name: liberusoftware/ecommerce-gift-cards-and-store-credit
description: A gift card is a bearer credential and a balance, and this package stores neither of them the way you would expect. The code is never in a column — only a keyed lookup index and a per-row hash — and the balance is a fold over an append-only ledger. Integer minor units, no default currency, and redemption against a different currency is refused rather than converted.
